name: swing
about: The avatar walks to the swinging thing, sits on its seat and swings back and forth higher and higher, laughing, then slows down and stays sitting.
code:
const it = args.thing || me.riding
if (!it) { me.say({ en: 'No swing!', fi: 'Ei keinua!' }); me.feel('silly'); yield* me.sitOn(null); return }
if (me.riding !== it) yield* me.ride(it)
me.feel('happy')
me.say({ en: 'Wheee!', fi: 'Jee!' })
const bx = me.x, by = me.y, bz = me.z, yaw = me.yaw
const top = it.anchor('top').y
const L = Math.max(0.8, top - by - 0.3)
const parts = it.parts || []
let last = 0
yield* w.during(10, (k) => {
  const amp = k < 0.7 ? 0.2 + k * 1.1 : (1 - k) / 0.3 * 0.97
  const a = amp * Math.sin(w.t * 3.2)
  me.x = bx + Math.sin(yaw) * Math.sin(a) * L
  me.z = bz + Math.cos(yaw) * Math.sin(a) * L
  me.y = by + (1 - Math.cos(a)) * L
  me.pitch = -a * 0.5
  for (const p of parts) it.part(p).rx = -a
  const leg = a > 0 ? 0.3 : -0.6
  me.pose.legL.swing = me.pose.legR.swing = 1.4 + leg
  me.pose.legL.bend = me.pose.legR.bend = 1.2 - leg
  me.pose.lean = -a * 0.4
  if (k < 0.75 && w.t - last > 2.2) { last = w.t; w.sound('giggle'); me.feel('happy'); w.puff({ at: me, kind: 'star', count: 5 }) }
})
for (const p of parts) it.part(p).rx = 0
me.x = bx; me.y = by; me.z = bz; me.pitch = 0
me.say({ en: 'So fun!', fi: 'Tosi kivaa!' })
yield* me.poseTo({ lean: 0, legL: { swing: 1.4, bend: 1.4 }, legR: { swing: 1.4, bend: 1.4 } })
